# First Response Property Solutions
> Property management support, inspections, and handyman services in Central Maryland. Veteran & first-responder owned.

First Response Property Solutions is a property services company serving Central Maryland: property management support for landlords and property managers, property inspections, handyman repairs, and interior/exterior maintenance including power washing, gutter cleaning, yard cleanup, debris removal, and fence & gate repair. The company is veteran and first-responder owned, licensed and insured, and provides free itemized estimates. <!-- TODO(client): confirm licensing details and ownership story. -->

## Services
- Property Management & Maintenance — turnovers, recurring maintenance, and on-call repairs for landlords, property managers, and out-of-town owners
- Property & Site Inspections — roof, drainage, gutter, and fence inspections with photo reports
- Handyman & General Repairs — interior and exterior repairs, punch lists, and odd jobs
- Power Washing & Exterior Cleaning — siding (vinyl/brick, up to two-story), porches, patios, walkways, and pavers
- Gutter Cleaning, Flush & Repair — cleaning, downspout flushing, re-securing, and minor repairs
- Yard Cleanup & Overgrowth Removal — overgrowth clearing, sapling and root removal, green-waste hauling
- Debris & Waste Removal — junk, brush, and project debris hauled (no hazardous materials)
- Fence & Gate Repair — gates rehung and aligned, posts reset, sections repaired, full-run inspections

## Service Area (Central Maryland)
Anne Arundel County, Howard County, Baltimore County, Prince George's County, Montgomery County, Carroll County, Frederick County, and Harford County.

## How It Works
Call or request online → walkthrough and free itemized estimate → scheduled work by one crew → final walkthrough with before/after photos and one clean invoice.

## FAQ

Q: What services do you offer?
A: Property management support, inspections, handyman repairs, power washing, gutter cleaning and repair, yard and overgrowth cleanup, debris removal (no HAZMAT), and fence & gate repair.

Q: Do you work with landlords and property managers?
A: Yes — turnovers, recurring maintenance, inspections, and on-call repairs, with photo documentation and itemized invoices that are easy to pass through to owners.

Q: How much does it cost?
A: Estimates are free and itemized. For straightforward jobs (debris piles, small repairs) we can often quote from photos.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Central Maryland, including Anne Arundel, Howard, Baltimore, Prince George's, Montgomery, Carroll, Frederick, and Harford counties.

Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes. We are licensed and insured to work on residential and rental properties in Maryland.
